name: Holmesglen Peter Grundy Scholarship (international students)
summary: Five $1,000 tuition credits for current Holmesglen international students hit by unexpected financial hardship.
key: Each scholarship has a value of $1,000, credited to tuition.
who: Current international students at Holmesglen in VET or higher education
Facing unexpected financial hardship during study
Not short courses or standalone English programs
